/bin/bash -lc "cat > internal/server/authz/engine/ext/extentions_test.go <<'EOF'
package ext

import (
	\"context\"
	\"fmt\"
	\"testing\"

	\"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/ast\"
	\"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/rego\"
	\"github.com/stretchr/testify/require\"
	\"go.flipt.io/flipt/rpc/flipt/auth\"
)

func TestIsAuthMethod(t *testing.T) {
	methods := []struct {
		name string
		code auth.Method
	}{
		{\"token\", auth.Method_METHOD_TOKEN},
		{\"oidc\", auth.Method_METHOD_OIDC},
		{\"kubernetes\", auth.Method_METHOD_KUBERNETES},
		{\"k8s\", auth.Method_METHOD_KUBERNETES},
		{\"github\", auth.Method_METHOD_GITHUB},
		{\"jwt\", auth.Method_METHOD_JWT},
		{\"cloud\", auth.Method_METHOD_CLOUD},
	}

	for _, method := range methods {
		t.Run(method.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			key := ast.StringTerm(method.name)
			matched := ast.MustParseTerm(fmt.Sprintf("'`{"authentication": {"method": %d}}`, method.code))
			result, err := isAuthMethod(rego.BuiltinContext{}, matched, key)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.Equal(t, ast.BooleanTerm(true), result)

			mismatched := ast.MustParseTerm(`{"authentication": {"method": 0}}`)
			result, err = isAuthMethod(rego.BuiltinContext{}, mismatched, key)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.Equal(t, ast.BooleanTerm(false), result)
		})
	}

	_, err := isAuthMethod(rego.BuiltinContext{}, ast.MustParseTerm(`{}`), ast.StringTerm("jwt"))
	require.EqualError(t, err, "no authentication found")

	_, err = isAuthMethod(rego.BuiltinContext{}, ast.MustParseTerm(`{"authentication": {"method": 1}}`), ast.StringTerm("unknown"))
	require.EqualError(t, err, "unsupported auth method: unknown")
}

func TestRegisteredBuiltin(t *testing.T) {
	query := rego.New(rego.Query(`flipt.is_auth_method(input, "jwt")`))
	prepared, err := query.PrepareForEval(context.Background())
	require.NoError(t, err)

	results, err := prepared.Eval(context.Background(), rego.EvalInput(map[string]any{
		"authentication": map[string]any{"method": int(auth.Method_METHOD_JWT)},
	}))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Len(t, results, 1)
}
EOF

package ext

import (
	\"context\"
	\"fmt\"
	\"testing\"

	\"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/ast\"
	\"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/rego\"
	\"github.com/stretchr/testify/require\"
	\"go.flipt.io/flipt/rpc/flipt/auth\"
)

func TestIsAuthMethod(t *testing.T) {
	methods := []struct {
		name string
		code auth.Method
	}{
		{\"token\", auth.Method_METHOD_TOKEN},
		{\"oidc\", auth.Method_METHOD_OIDC},
		{\"kubernetes\", auth.Method_METHOD_KUBERNETES},
		{\"k8s\", auth.Method_METHOD_KUBERNETES},
		{\"github\", auth.Method_METHOD_GITHUB},
		{\"jwt\", auth.Method_METHOD_JWT},
		{\"cloud\", auth.Method_METHOD_CLOUD},
	}

	for _, method := range methods {
		t.Run(method.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			key := ast.StringTerm(method.name)
			matched := ast.MustParseTerm(fmt.Sprintf("'`{"authentication": {"method": %d}}`, method.code))
			result, err := isAuthMethod(rego.BuiltinContext{}, matched, key)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.Equal(t, ast.BooleanTerm(true), result)

			mismatched := ast.MustParseTerm(`{"authentication": {"method": 0}}`)
			result, err = isAuthMethod(rego.BuiltinContext{}, mismatched, key)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.Equal(t, ast.BooleanTerm(false), result)
		})
	}

	_, err := isAuthMethod(rego.BuiltinContext{}, ast.MustParseTerm(`{}`), ast.StringTerm("jwt"))
	require.EqualError(t, err, "no authentication found")

	_, err = isAuthMethod(rego.BuiltinContext{}, ast.MustParseTerm(`{"authentication": {"method": 1}}`), ast.StringTerm("unknown"))
	require.EqualError(t, err, "unsupported auth method: unknown")
}

func TestRegisteredBuiltin(t *testing.T) {
	query := rego.New(rego.Query(`flipt.is_auth_method(input, "jwt")`))
	prepared, err := query.PrepareForEval(context.Background())
	require.NoError(t, err)

	results, err := prepared.Eval(context.Background(), rego.EvalInput(map[string]any{
		"authentication": map[string]any{"method": int(auth.Method_METHOD_JWT)},
	}))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Len(t, results, 1)
}
EOF
